summary: Completed full backend testing of HRMS Reporting Module Phase B (PF ECR, ESI Return, TDS, Form 16 PDF) and Phase C (Leave Balance, YTD Earnings). 22 new pytest cases parse Excel bytes via openpyxl and verify %PDF signature for Form 16. All 22/22 PASSED. Combined with Phase A from iteration 209, the complete HRMS reports suite now has 38/38 tests passing with no regressions.

minor.issue: When no employees are covered (all > 21000), file is generated with an empty-state note but no TOTAL row. Behavior matches the spec. OK.

GRAND TOTAL row has no value in column 7 (Avg Monthly TDS) and column 8 (Months Processed). Merging only columns 1-3 leaves col 5 (Annual Basic) blank in total row too — acceptable but slightly asymmetrical vs salary-register.
Form 16 signature block uses COMPANY_ADDRESS.split(',')[-2] to guess Place — fragile if address format changes (currently works: 'Chatrapati Sambhaji Nagar'). Cosmetic.

Leave balance defaults to {cl:12, sl:12, el:21} if employee lacks the field — but CL/SL Totals in Excel read from the same fallback, so TOTAL==12 always for unset employees. Consider explicit 'Not Configured' marker.
No auth guard on reports endpoints (same note as iteration 209). Acceptable for MVP, should be protected before production.

action_items: (Optional) Fill Avg Monthly TDS & Months Processed cells in TDS GRAND TOTAL row.
(Optional) Compute Place in Form 16 from a config field rather than splitting address string.
(Optional) Distinguish 'default' vs 'configured' CL/SL totals in leave-balance report.
(Pre-prod) Add auth/role guard to /api/employees/reports/* before launch.
critical_code_review_comments: employee_reports.py is now 1400+ lines — STRONGLY recommend splitting by report (pf.py, esi.py, tds.py, form16.py, leave_balance.py, ytd.py, salary_register.py, salary_slip.py, attendance.py, pool.py, analytics.py) for maintainability. Was 879 lines last iteration, has grown ~60%.

Duplicated loop logic: PF ECR, TDS, Form 16, and YTD all re-compute att+breakdown+deductions per month — extract a shared helper `compute_month_payslip(emp, month, year)` returning dict with {adj_gross, adj_basic, ded, lop, net}.

Form 16 Part B: Section 16 rendering shows Professional Tax u/s 16(iii) but does NOT subtract standard deduction 50,000 from the PT line — the '5. Income chargeable' formula is correct (gross - 50000 - pt), but the visual flow is confusing to a tax reviewer. Consider reformatting.

TDS calculation in calculate_deductions uses gross*12 as annual proxy per month — this OVERESTIMATES TDS when attendance_ratio < 1, because gross is already adjusted. For FY-level TDS, use monthly_salary (full) * 12, not the ratio-adjusted gross. This is a minor accuracy bug for TDS projection but matches existing Phase A salary-register/slip behavior.
Good: Wage capping at 15000 for EPF/EPS/EDLI is correctly applied and verified by tests.
Good: ESI ceiling check (<=21000) on adjusted gross is correctly implemented.
Good: FastAPI Query validators (ge/le) produce proper 422 for invalid month/year.
Good: 404 correctly raised for non-existent employee in form-16 and ytd-earnings.
Good: All endpoints return proper Content-Type + Content-Disposition with correct file names.
test_credentials: none — endpoints have no auth gate per MVP
